messages.subject: Welcome to Mark Agency. Please remain employed.
messages.body:
Welcome, {{agentName}}.

You are now a member of Mark Agency: an international organisation dedicated to recovering stolen artifacts and locating whoever last borrowed the good stapler.

Your workstation is ready. Your colleagues are mostly ready. Your chair has been approved for seated use only.

Before considering yourself fully equipped, collect your Agency Field Manual from the Storage Room as soon as your storage clearance is granted. This is mandatory. Standing near a manual does not count as reading it.

We look forward to a long and administratively uneventful relationship.

Marge
Human Resources
Humans preferred. Resources negotiable.

messages.subject: ACTION REQUIRED: collect your Field Manual
messages.body:
Agent {{agentName}},

Collect your Agency Field Manual from the Storage Room once your access is enabled.

It covers evidence handling, travel procedures, paperwork, and the difference between 'undercover' and 'wearing sunglasses indoors'.

The manual is issued, not gifted. Please do not sell it, swap it for a mysterious amulet, or submit it as your own mission report.

If the Storage Room is still locked, wait for clearance. Picking the lock would demonstrate initiative in exactly the wrong department.

Murphy
P.S. There is no audiobook. Frank offered to record one. HR intervened.

messages.subject: Reports require words. Preferably the correct ones.
messages.body:
A successful arrest does not complete your paperwork. It merely creates paperwork with a more optimistic ending.

Open MISSION REPORT on the agency computer. Fill in the artifact, the escape route in order, and the thief's real name. Print the document. Bring it to me in the archive.

Do not write 'see previous international incident'. Do not attach the suspect instead of their name.

Once your report is filed, you may talk to me. You may also review your next assignment. These are separate activities. Please enjoy the distinction.

messages.subject: Password update: PASSWORD2 is not a plot twist
messages.body:
Please choose a password that is not:

- PASSWORD
- PASSWORD2
- the word 'confidential'
- a colleague's name followed by their birthday
- whatever is currently written on your monitor

Changing PASSWORD to PASSWORD! does not make you an intelligence operative.

If you receive an email asking for your credentials, report it. If it is signed 'Definitely Commissioner Gordon', report it twice.

messages.subject: Your receipts are not experimental literature
messages.body:
The following expense descriptions have been rejected:

'Morale support' - twelve cocktails.
'Local intelligence' - a novelty snow globe.
'Operational camouflage' - a sequinned cape.
'Emergency extraction' - a taxi from the hotel buffet.

Please use ordinary descriptions. Ordinary lies are easier to audit.

A reminder: the agency budget is not your personal money. Your personal money is the smaller, sadder number.

messages.subject: The Mark Monthly: morale up, ceiling down
messages.body:
THIS MONTH AT MARK AGENCY

RECOVERIES: Three valuable objects have been returned to their rightful owners. One was a mug. We are counting it.

FACILITIES: A ceiling tile has voluntarily joined the open-plan office. Please stop calling it a skylight.

PEOPLE: Congratulations to the colleague who completed a travel claim without using the phrase 'long story'.

WELLBEING: Our lunchtime mindfulness session has been cancelled so the organiser can urgently find the mindfulness folder.

You received this newsletter because you work here. There is no unsubscribe button. There is an exit, but HR keeps an eye on it.

messages.subject: Found: umbrella. Weather history classified.
messages.body:
A black umbrella has been found in Meeting Room B.

It is dry on the outside and wet on the inside. We have decided not to investigate.

To claim it, describe the handle and explain why it contains a train timetable, two sugar packets, and a photograph of another umbrella.

If nobody claims it by Friday, it will be promoted to office equipment.

messages.subject: Missing: one left shoe, size embarrassing
messages.body:
Would the owner of the left shoe in the evidence refrigerator please contact Reception?

The shoe is not currently part of a case. The sandwich beside it is also not part of a case, despite what the label says.

Please bring proof of ownership. Your other foot will probably do.

Do not send a plaster cast. We know what you people are like.

messages.subject: New kitchen labelling policy
messages.body:
All food in the communal refrigerator must be labelled with a name and a date.

Acceptable: 'Marge - Tuesday'.
Unacceptable: 'Exhibit A'.
Also unacceptable: 'Possibly Marge - possibly Tuesday'.

A biohazard sticker does not reserve a shelf.

The unlabelled jar on the bottom shelf has been given its own name and date. It is now Dennis, and it has been here longer than most of you.

messages.subject: Printer procedure revised after the incident
messages.body:
If the printer jams:

1. Open the paper tray.
2. Remove the jammed paper.
3. Close the paper tray.

Do not threaten it with arrest. Do not dust it for fingerprints. Do not send it a ransom demand for the missing page.

The 'PRINT' button is a request, not a legally binding agreement.

We cannot provide a witness protection programme for printers.

messages.subject: Meeting Room C is not a safe house
messages.body:
Please stop booking Meeting Room C under the names 'Nobody', 'Definitely Empty', and 'Witness 4'.

A meeting room becomes a safe house only after approval from Operations. Drawing curtains on the whiteboard does not count.

The person currently living behind the projector screen has until 16:00 to finish their presentation or move out.

messages.subject: Please do not reply all to this instruction
messages.body:
Please do not reply all to this message.

We are aware that the previous message saying 'please do not reply all' generated 63 replies, including 18 requests to be removed from the conversation and one confession.

The confession has been forwarded to the appropriate department.

This is not a test. If it were a test, the answer would still not be REPLY ALL.

messages.subject: Special edition: a case was solved. We noticed.
messages.body:
A COLLEAGUE HAS SUCCESSFULLY COMPLETED A MISSION

Operations has expressed satisfaction. Finance has expressed reservations. The printer has expressed a noise.

EMPLOYEE RECOGNITION: Please enjoy this sentence congratulating you. It has been approved in place of cake.

PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Our seminar 'How Not to Look Suspicious' has been moved after all attendees arrived separately wearing identical coats.

REMINDER: A solved case is a wonderful thing to include in a completed report.

messages.subject: Recovered artifacts are not office supplies
messages.body:
Recovered artifacts may not be used as:

- paperweights
- doorstops
- lunch bowls
- improvised trophies
- anything described as 'just for a minute'

The ancient ceremonial vessel in Accounting is to be returned immediately. Finance insists it makes the best tea. The museum insists it has been empty for several thousand years.

Both departments would like the discussion documented.

messages.subject: Found: visitor badge bearing the name VISITOR
messages.body:
A visitor badge has been found near the elevators. It belongs to a person named VISITOR.

Our investigation has established that they visited.

If you know VISITOR, please ask them to visit Reception. If you are VISITOR, please bring something more specific than the badge.

Frank suggested checking under V. We have asked him to return to the archive.

messages.subject: Quarterly report: still an agency
messages.body:
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Recovered artifacts: improving.
Missing office pens: deteriorating.
Meetings that could have been emails: now emails that could have been silence.

SUSTAINABILITY: We have reduced paper consumption by declaring several forms emotionally optional. They remain administratively mandatory.

TEAM BUILDING: The escape-room event has been cancelled. Several colleagues refused to leave because the alibi was too good.

Thank you for continuing to embody our values, once somebody finds the document listing them.

messages.subject: Found: keys labelled NOT THE VAULT
messages.body:
A set of keys labelled NOT THE VAULT has been handed to Security.

For obvious reasons, we have not tested them on the vault. For equally obvious reasons, somebody else already has.

The owner should contact Security and explain the smaller tag reading 'SERIOUSLY, NOT THE VAULT'.

Do not claim them simply because you enjoy a challenge.

messages.subject: Case closed. Paperwork very much open.
messages.body:
Agent {{agentName}},

Your mission has been marked successful. Your report has not been marked anything, because I do not have it.

Open MISSION REPORT, complete the blanks and print it. Then bring the document to the archive.

After filing, your next assignment can be reviewed. Until then, please resist the urge to begin another international incident.

Frank
Case reference: {{caseId}}

messages.subject: Report accepted. More work available.
messages.body:
Agent {{agentName}},

Your successful mission and filed report have been recorded. Congratulations: your reward for finishing work is the opportunity to consider more work.

Your next assignment is ready for review. Select NEXT ASSIGNMENT below when you are ready.

This opens the assignment review screen. It does not accept the mission for you. You may decline for now and return to the office.

Feel free to finish your conversation with Frank first. He assures us this is a privilege.

Operations
Case reference: {{caseId}}
